posts.title: Identity Verification is as Bad as It Can Be
posts.description: This is an addendum to OS-Level Age Attestation is the Good One , where I talk about the potential of legal standards for age attestation as an alternative to age verification. posts.title: What Was The Beginner's Guide About?
posts.description: This entirely spoils the experience of first playing The Beginner’s Guide and assumes you’re familiar with the basic plot. If you’re interested, please play The Beginner’s Guide first. It’s a $5-$10 experience that lasts about an hour and a half. It’s so good that I wrote about it.
